pipeline_mapping: d30 opening anchor: water as propellant feedstock. Electrolysed water burned as GH2/GO2 measured Isp over 350 s (355 s on a 22-N thruster, projected over 380 s), superior to Earth-storable propellants, and water stores at 1.0 g/cc in light low-pressure tanks. Supports water 1.00 (base) in IN_SPACE_UTILITY as a drop-in substitute for launched propellant; the iridium-coated rhenium chambers it needs are a manufactured in-space use of Ir and Re, which the trace rows (0.00) leave to Earth fabrication
